analysis_plan.analysis_sets: An analysis is one prediction on one dataset (all its parts), one kill-rule check or one descriptive table; its systems are the union of the families it names (analysis_set_families). Each analysis uses its clean subset: the images for which every caption of every one of its systems is clean. A Vietnamese caption is clean if rescap.vlm.mock.looks_vietnamese is true and clean_supervision.CJK_RE finds no match; an English caption is clean if CJK_RE finds no match; a sample pool is clean if all its samples are clean. Images missing from any run of the analysis are dropped from it. Verdicts use clean subsets only (H3 section 2 P3: score only the clean subset and say so). The same statistics on all images are reported as a sensitivity analysis, without verdicts. The clean-subset size of every analysis is reported.
analysis_plan.local_copies: The evaluator reads the backup copies under .session_backup/machines/<machine>/root/outputs/g2b_qwen3vl/ and checks each against its .sha256 sidecar first
analysis_plan.random_subsets: numpy.random.default_rng(1); for k = 1..K (K = 4 on cv295 and uv231, 1 on xm600), for r = 1..20, for each image of the FULL dataset in id order: choice(n_refs_image, k, replace=False). Drawn once per dataset, before any output is read, then restricted to the analysis set.
analysis_plan.bootstrap: 1000 image-bootstrap draws per analysis set: numpy.random.default_rng(0).multinomial(N, [1/N]*N, size=1000) over the set's images in id order, shared by every system, gold and family of the analysis (paired). 95% CI = percentiles 2.5 and 97.5 of the replicates.

statistics.per_system: For system x, gold variant g with subsets s = 1..S (S = n_random_subsets for *_randk, else 1) and image weights w over the analysis set: TP_xs = sum_i w_i |m_xi & G_is|; Mtot_x = sum_i w_i |m_xi|; P_xs = TP_xs / Mtot_x; R_xs = mean over images with non-empty G_is of |m_xi & G_is| / |G_is| (w-weighted); F_xs = 2 P R / (P + R), 0 if P + R = 0. P_x, R_x, F_x = means over s; M_x = Mtot_x / sum_i w_i; TPbar_x = P_x * M_x (check_mstar.prf, mixed F1). For oiv7_verified, P, R and F1 are the OIV7 quantities of the gold definition (verified precision, micro recall over verified-present classes, F1_pos), w-weighted, and TPbar_x = P_x * M_x with M_x from objects_in.
statistics.slope[g](F): OLS slope of 100 * F_x on ln M_x over the systems x of family F (check_mstar.slope)
statistics.b[g](F): OLS slope of ln max(TPbar_x, 1e-09) on ln M_x over F (check_mstar.mstar b; two systems give the two-point slope)
statistics.res[g](y | F): 100 * P_y - 100 * exp(a_F) * M_y ** (b_F - 1), with (a_F, b_F) the OLS fit of ln TPbar on ln M over F (g2_frontier.fit residual, in precision points)
statistics.mres[g](Y | F): mean of res[g](y | F) over the systems y of Y
statistics.rmse[g](F): sqrt(mean over x in F of res[g](x | F) ** 2), point estimate (g2_frontier rmse_ols_P)
statistics.differences: a difference of two statistics is computed on the same bootstrap draw (paired)

descriptive_outputs: per system and gold: P, R, F1, M and TPbar with CIs
slope[g](LADDER) and b[g](LADDER) for every gold variant, with CIs, including the multi-reference golds whose sign is not predicted (CC-007)
M*_mixed and sign(slope) vs sign(M*_mixed - median M) per gold (check_mstar.mstar): a goodness-of-fit check, not a prediction (H3 section 1a: close to built in)
every registered statistic on all images (sensitivity), and on the uv231 secondary lexicon
clean-subset sizes; share of captions failing each guard, per run
analysis_plan.evaluator: Written after this registration, against Sections 'analysis_plan' and 'predictions'. It reuses the pinned matchers unchanged and reproduces the conventions of the pinned reference implementations. Its sha256 goes into its results JSON; it is committed through the gatekeeper before its results file exists (CHECKLIST C3).

verdict_rules.sign_gt_0: PASS if ci95_lo > 0; FAIL if point <= 0; else INCONCLUSIVE
verdict_rules.sign_lt_0: PASS if ci95_hi < 0; FAIL if point >= 0; else INCONCLUSIVE
verdict_rules.equiv_abs_le: PASS if -delta <= ci95_lo and ci95_hi <= delta; FAIL if ci95_hi < -delta or ci95_lo > delta; else INCONCLUSIVE
verdict_rules.diff_abs_gt: PASS if ci95_lo > delta or ci95_hi < -delta; FAIL if -delta <= ci95_lo and ci95_hi <= delta; else INCONCLUSIVE
verdict_rules.compound: FAIL if any part is FAIL; else NOT_EVALUABLE if any part is NOT_EVALUABLE; else PASS if every part is PASS; else INCONCLUSIVE
verdict_rules.not_evaluable: NOT_EVALUABLE if the analysis set is empty or a statistic is undefined (a system with M_x = 0, or fewer than 2 distinct M_x in a family)
verdict_rules.counting: Kill rules count FAIL only. INCONCLUSIVE is reported as inconclusive and never as support. Earlier preregistrations scored sign and ordering claims on point estimates; 'not FAIL' here is that criterion, so the outcomes can be compared.
verdict_rules.multiplicity: No correction; every prediction is reported separately, per dataset, with its CI.

predictions.text: one-reference endpoint: the verbosity slope is negative under one random reference (the empirical half of N1; Paper A does not derive this sign from Proposition 1)

predictions.source: CC-007 binding note; H3 section 2 P3
predictions.text: complete-gold endpoint: the verbosity slope is positive under the complete gold (the large-gold endpoint of Proposition 1)

predictions.source: CC-007 binding note; H3 section 2 P3
predictions.text: ordering (Proposition 1): slope(one reference) < slope(all references) < slope(complete gold)
exponent ordering: b(all references) - b(one reference) > 0 and b(complete) > b(all references)
the sign of slope[refs_all](LADDER) and of slope[refsK_randk](LADDER), K >= 2, is NOT predicted; it is reported with its CI only

predictions.source: H3 P6 and COCO-2500 P1 (k-step form)
predictions.text: the verbosity slope rises at every added reference, k = 1..5
language-free exponent: |b_EN - b_VI| <= 0.05 under the complete gold
vote family vs greedy prompt family: |b difference| <= 0.05 under the complete gold
temperature leaves the exponent within 0.05 and lowers the T=0.8 intercept (complete gold)
backbones share the exponent within 0.05 but differ in intercept by more than 2 precision points at matched M (complete gold; Qwen2.5-VL-7B zero-shot comparator)

kill_rules.action: Section 7.6 drops the completeness account for this backbone and reports only that the exponent is dataset-specific

kill_rules.rule: G2B-P2 is FAIL on both cv295 and uv231. G2's K2 counts backbones (2 or more of 3); here one backbone has English outputs, so K2 cannot be evaluated as written
kill_rules.action: Section 7.6 reports the exponent per language for Qwen3-VL-8B

kill_rules.rule: rmse[g](LADDER) > 3 precision points (point estimate) for a gold variant g of a dataset (Section 5 variants, primary lexicon)
kill_rules.action: for that dataset and gold the frontier is reported only as a local linearisation around its operating range: no extrapolated frontier value and no M* reading

the C3 kappa tests of H3 section 2 P3 are left out: Paper B owns C3 (PD-6 Q1(a))

the English arm is the greedy short/detailed pair of this backbone on CV295 and UV231 (G2 section 4 planned English and Vietnamese prompt families for three backbones); XM600 has no English-to-OIV7 class map, so it has no English arm
K2 is evaluated in a restricted form, because only one backbone has English outputs
clean-subset scoring is applied in every case (H3 section 2 P3 makes it conditional on a failed dev300 language guard)
every sign and ordering claim, including the second part of G2 P1 (b(instance) > b(5 refs), stated there without an interval), is scored with the three-way rule of Section 8
G2B-P3b (temperature ladder) is added from G2's H3 and the D15 MT19 rationale for the ladder; G2 section 4 P3 itself is G2B-P3a
UV231 handling: D15's 'uncontaminated' premise does not hold for UV231 (Section 4)

exposure.criterion: membership in COCO train2017, the criterion of D15 and the S0 contamination caveat; it is not proof that a backbone never saw an image
exposure.uv231_flag: D15 MT19 lists UIT-ViIC test among the uncontaminated splits and says G2-B runs with 'zero touch of COCO train2017'. Every UV231 image is a COCO train2017 image (datasets.uv231.coco_url_split, datasets.uv231.coco2014_split), so that premise is wrong for UV231.
exposure.uv231_handling: registered default, for the judge to confirm before the commit: UV231 is decoded and analysed as registered; its FAIL outcomes count toward every kill rule; a PASS on UV231 is not counted as support from images outside COCO train2017; Paper A labels UV231 results 'COCO train2017 images; exposure during pre-training possible'
